Interface GameTestScaffold.Automation

Enclosing class:
GameTestScaffold
public static interface GameTestScaffold.Automation
A stack block's inventory as a hopper or pipe reaches it through the loader: Forge's and NeoForge's IItemHandler capability or Fabric's Transfer API storage. Each loader's support class supplies one, so a shared scenario drives the same automation surface on every loader. Insertion returns what was left over, and neither call changes the stack it is given.
